name: agent2web
description: Self-hosted static site hosting with an MCP publishing API, for HTML built by AI tools like Claude

DB.description: Stores sites, versions, the file index, OAuth tokens and sessions. Nothing to configure — accept the suggested name.

BLOBS.description: Holds the published files themselves. Nothing to configure — accept the suggested name.

A2W_SECRET.description: Signs cookies and hashes tokens at rest. Run `npm run gen-secrets` in a clone of this repo, or paste any random string of 32+ characters.

A2W_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH.description: Your admin password, hashed. Run `npm run gen-secrets` to get one — it prints the hash to paste here and the password to keep. **Save the password: only the hash is stored.**

A2W_API_TOKEN.description: Optional. A bearer token so Claude Code, curl and CI can publish without a browser sign-in. `npm run gen-secrets` prints one. Leave empty to require the OAuth flow.

A2W_ADMIN_TOTP_SECRET.description: Optional. A base32 secret from your authenticator app, if you want a 6-digit code as well as the password. Leave empty to skip.

A2W_PUBLIC_URL.description: Leave empty. The Worker learns its own URL from the first request. Only set this once you attach a custom domain, as the exact origin, e.g. `https://a2w.example.com`.

A2W_SITES_BASE_DOMAIN.description: Leave empty. Only for serving each site at `<slug>.yourdomain.com`, which needs a domain on Cloudflare with a proxied wildcard record — impossible on workers.dev.

A2W_MAX_SITE_BYTES.description: Largest site accepted, in bytes. The default of 25 MB fits inside a Worker’s memory once content is base64-decoded.
